title: What the Rain Found Them Doing | Three-Quarter Town
description:
In Three-Quarter Town, rain never arrives in a hurry.
It finds an old woman by the window, a black cat curled on a blanket, sheep waiting patiently beneath the eaves, and quiet hands still busy with tea, music, letters, and small familiar work.

Some stay inside by the fire. Some step out to check the barn. Some simply watch the rain move across the rooftops until evening comes.

A gentle rainy-day story about solitude, companionship, and the little things people keep doing when the world turns soft and gray.

— Three-Quarter Town

#ThreeQuarterTown #RainyDay #BlackCat #CozyAnimation #StopMotionStyle
